high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website "science.thewire.in." The content discusses the parasite Crithidia bombi, which lives in the intestines of bumble bees. The text explains that the parasite is transmitted through contact with infected individuals or their feces and relies on an unbroken chain of transmission from queens of one generation to queens of the next. The article mentions research conducted by Jacqui Shykoff and Paul Schmid-Hempel at ETH Zurich, who experimentally infected some bumble bee colonies in their laboratory with Crithidia bombi.
